summary: AAP 2.6 links logins from any authenticator to an existing account when there is a single verified email match; later logins use the external UID, a changed UID re-runs email linking, and a changed email creates a new account. This replaces 2.5's hashed usernames like username-abc123.
questions: Why does AAP create a duplicate user when someone logs in with a different authenticator?
How does AAP 2.6 link users across authenticators?
What happens when a user's email changes in the IdP?
